content: Dinab Aurin Merarayow En
Jesu efan nati ihamiy matabir maiye ana bai’ufununayah hitur bairi hina ana bar ana merar hitit.

Baiyarir ana veya Kou’ay Baremaim busuruf sabuw i’obaibiyih, naatu sabuw moumurih ana tur hinonowar i hifofofor naatu hio, “Iti orot menamaim kirum so’ob? Naatu not rerekab yait itin ina’inanen fokarih esisinaf?
Iti orot i bar wowabayan. Mary natun taitin James, Joseph, Judas naatu Simon, ruburubun baibitar iti’imaim bairit tama’am?” Iti na’atube hio naatu hikwahir.
Naatu Jesu hai tur eowen bar merar afa’amaim dinab orot i tekakakafiy, baise orot taiyuwin ana bar merar, ana sabuw, ana rara men tekakakafiy.
Naatu ana bar meraramaim ina’inan men ta sinaf, sawusawuwih bai’abamo biyah botobonen hiyawas.
Sabuw men hibitumatum isan Jesu ifofofor men kafai ta. Jesu Orot 12 Iyafarih Hitit Naatu bar merar afa run tit sabuw i’obaibiyih remor.
Ana bai’ufununayah nah 12 eafih hina hitit afiy kakafih nunih isan fair itih naatu orot rouru’ab iyafarih hitit.
Naatu iuwih, “Remor kwanabubusuruf a tu akisin kwanab, men sawar ta, men rafiy, men hafoy, naatu men kabay ta kwanab naiw a kikiramaim kwanarobere.
A baibiyon kwaniyoun, baise biya baibiyon men bairou’abin kwanab.”
Naatu iuwih, “Bar merar menatan kwarur imaim kwanama kwanabow nanan a veya nab imaibo nati bar merar kwanihamiy.
Naatu efan menamaim a merar men hinay hinabubuwi, o fana men hinanonowar kwana’orarafih kwanana’ufut tafaram kwanihamiy kwanan, nati i hai baimatnuwen!”
Basit hitit hin bowabow kakafihine dogor baikitabiren isan hibinan.
Wagabur moumurih maiyow hinunih hitit naatu sawusawuwih moumurih na’in biyah raiy hirarouw etei hiyawas.
Herod, John Baptist Asabun
Jesu wabin ra’at aiwob orot Herod nowar, anayabin sabuw afa hio’o Iti i John Baptist morobone misir maiye, imih biyanamaim fair ma ina’inanen ta ta sinaf temamatar.
Afa hio, “Iti i Elijah. Afa ibanak hio’o, ‘Iti i marasika dinab orot ta na tit.’”
Baise Herod nonowar ana maramaim eo, “John sikan abuburu’um i morobone misir maiye?”
Anayabin Herod taiyuwin iuwih John hifatum hibai hin dibur baremaim hiyaru’uy. Iti sisinaf ana’an i Herod tain Philip aawan bi’awan isan.
Anayabin Herod tain aawan bi’aawan isan John gam tur fokarin maiyow eo, “O i ofafar iastu’ub yawas kakafin kusisinaf.”
Imih Herodias yan so’ar kok kwanekwan boro John ta’asabun, baise ef men ta ma boro tasinaf.
Baise Herod i John isan birubir anayabin i so’ob John i orot kakafiyin, ana yawas mutufurin imih tatafafar, John binan Herod nonowar ana not i’afiy baise Herod ana kok i John tabinan i tanowar.
Basit veya gewasin ta Herod tutufuw ana veya baiyasisir isan hiyuw bogaigiwas, ana sabuw nukwanukwarih, baiyowayah nukwanukwarih, naatu Galilee wanawanan sabuw gagamih etei e’af ayuwih.
Nati’imaim Herodias natun babitai na run benaben Herod ana nanawan sabuw hiru’ay hima’am etei hiyasisir men kikimin ta. Naatu aiwob babitai iu, “Abisa kukokok inifefeyan ayu boro anit?”
Naatu babitai isan eobaifaro eo, “Abisa isan inifefeyan au aiwob turin auman boro anit.”
Babitai in hinah ibatiy, “Ayu boro abisa isan anifefeyan?” Hinah iya’afut iu, “John Baptist ukwarin!”
Babitai matan kabiy in aiwob biyan tit ifefeyan eo, “Ayu akokok John Baptist ukwarin tew yan inayai iti boun inab inan initu.”
Aiwob orot yababan gagamin bai, baise men karam sabuw matahamaim babitai isan eo’obaifaro ta’astu’ub.
Mar ta’imonamo tur iyafar sika afu’afuw orot iyun in John dibur baremaim ma’am sikan buru’um.
Naatu ukwarin tew yan iwan bai na babitai itin imaibo bai in hinah itin.
John ana bai’ufununayah tur hinonowar ana veya hina biyan hibai hin rahamaim hiyai.
Jesu Sabuw 5,000 Ituwih
Tur Abarayah himatabir hina Jesu biyan hitit mi’itube hibowabow naatu sabuw hibi’obaiyih ana tur hi’owen.
Naatu Jesu iuwih eo, “Tarabon tan efan sira’utubinamaim mar kafai taniyarir. Anayabin sabuw moumurih Jesu isan hirun hititit, ana bai’ufununayah bay men karam boro hitaa.
Imih akisihimo wa afe’en hisra’at hin efan ana sira’utubinamaim hitit.
Baise hinan sabuw moumurih na’in hi’itih hi’inanih, naatu hai bar hai merar hihamiyen aunah hi’iyon hina hima isan hikakaif na run,
wa’ane bisure auman sabuw kou’ay gagamin hima’am itih iyababan, anayabin iti sabuw i sheep na’atube aurih nabatanenayan en, naatu busuruf sawar moumurih na’in i’obaibiyih.
Veya ra’iy birabirab auman, ana bai’ufununayah hina biyan hitit hio, “Iti efan i yok na’in naatu veya i sawar,
sabuw kwiyafarih ten bar merar afa iti yubinamaim naatu masaw baremaim bay hinatobon hinaa.”

Baise Jesu iyafutih eo, “Kwa a efanamaim abisa ema’am i kwaitih te’aan.” Naatu hiya’afut hio, “Bay nati na’atube i boro sumar etei eight orot ta’imon ana baiyan ana fofonin tanatobon sabuw tanituwih.”
Jesu ibatiyih, “Kwa rafiy fafar bai’ab isa tema’am? Kwan kwa’itin.” Hin hiso’ob hina ana tur hi’owen rafiy fafar etei five naatu siy rou’ab.
Imaibo Jesu eo, “Sabuw kwa’uwih matan, matan fotan gewasin yan timarir.”
Naatu sabuw hi’uwih matan, matan fotan gewasin yan himarir, afa 100 na’atube afa 50 na’atube.
Jesu rafiy five naatu siy rou’ab auman bow au mar nuw ra’at God ana merar yi imseseben ana bai’ufununayah itih hibow sabuw hifaramih.
Sabuw etei nati bay hi’aa hai fofonin bai.
Ana bai’ufununayah rafiy rebarebah, naatu siy turih sabuw hi’aa hibow sakasak etei 12 hiwan foten.
Oro’orot bay hi’aa i etei 5,000.
Jesu Harew Tafan Bat Remor
Mar ta’imonamo Jesu ana bai’ufununayah iuwih wa hisra’at au Bethsaida wan iyafarih hirabon naatu i baise ma sabuw itubabarih hai ubar hin.
Sabuw itubarih hinan ufunamaim yoyobanamih yen in oyaw wan tit.
Birabirab auman wa re in kuyowen naatu Jesu akisinamo i me yanamaim ma.
Ana bai’ufununayah i’itih i hiboy hibi’akir, anayabin yourabad nahine bababin, mar tot auman Jesu tit riy yan bat remor in biyah tit tanatabirihimih.
Baise hinuw harew yan bat remor nan hi’itin ana veya wagabur mowan ta hirouw hitar koukuw.
Anayabin Jesu iti na’atube sinaf hi’itin i hibir men kikimin ta, baise Jesu matan kabiy iuwih eo, “Ya hinakwat! Men kwanabirumih! Ayu anan.”
Naatu wa afe’en yen nuwarob eafuw ana bai’ufununayah hifofofor men kafaita.
Anayabin rafiy bimasib ana kirikirifot men hiso’ob, baise dogorohine i fokar.
Iyab Jesu Biyan Hibubutubun I Hiyawas.
Naatu harew hirabon tafaram Genesaret imaim hirun hai wa hirouw,
wa’ane hitit hirara’iy ana veya sabuw Jesu hi’itin hi’inan.
Naatu nati tafaram wanawanan sabuw himatkabikabiy hinunuw sawusawuwih emo’em hiwan hi’abar Jesu ana tur hinonowar imaim hi’abar hin.

Bar merar kikimin o gagamin, naatu masaw bar imaim inan ana tur hinonowar, sawusawuwih hibow hitit ahar efanamaim hiya hifefeyan hai kok i mi’itube ana waifuw yomaninawat hitabutubun. Naatu sabuw etei Jesu hibubutubun iyawasih.
